question: The average weight of Rakesh, Shivam and Rupesh is 46 kg. If the average weight of Rakesh and Shivam be 40 kg and that of Shivam and Rupesh be 48 kg, then the weight of Shivam (in kg) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight of the overlapping person = Overall Average + Net Deviation

Overall average of 3 persons = 46 kg

Deviation of Rakesh & Shivam = (40 − 46) × 2 = −12 kg

Deviation of Shivam & Rupesh = (48 − 46) × 2 = +4 kg

Weight of Shivam = 46 − 12 + 4 = 38 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 38 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of Rakesh, Shivam and Rupesh = 46 kg

Average weight of Rakesh and Shivam = 40 kg

Average weight of Shivam and Rupesh = 48 kg
